reveal_en: The stars you gaze upon are often long gone. Their light, traveling across light-years, finally reaches your eye.
reveal_zh: 你凝望的星辰，或许早已消逝。它们的光，跨越光年，此刻才抵达你的双眸。
meaning_en: Every twinkle is a journey through time. You are seeing history, touching the past with your eyes, connecting to distant cosmic echoes.
meaning_zh: 每次闪烁都是一场时光之旅。你目睹着历史，用双眼触碰过去，连接遥远的宇宙回响。

visual.motion: Slow, gentle shimmer of distant light
